description: This file implements Sonos device discovery, monitoring, and control functions, including SSDP discovery callbacks, speaker monitoring threads, and HTTP commands to control Sonos speakers.

methods.name: sonosStartDiscovery
methods.description: Starts SSDP discovery for Sonos devices with a callback for discovered speakers.

methods.name: sonosStopDiscovery
methods.description: Stops SSDP discovery for Sonos devices.

methods.name: sonosPlayClip
methods.description: Sends a command to a Sonos speaker to play a clip via HTTP PUT request.

methods.name: sonosSpeakerDestroy
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a SonosSpeaker object.

methods.name: sonosStartMonitoring
methods.description: Starts monitoring a specific Sonos speaker for IP address changes.

methods.name: sonosStopMonitoring
methods.description: Stops monitoring a specific Sonos speaker.
